question: The battle in which Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi was the:
solution:
Correct answer is__** Battle of Panipat.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The First Battle of Panipat was challenge between the invading forces of **Babur and the Lodi Empire,** which happened on **21 April 1526 in North India.**
 
• It marked the starting of the** Mughal Empire.**
 
• This was one of the earliest battles involving **gunpowderfirearms and field artillery.**
 
• Babur was invited by **Daulat Khan Lodi **to enter India and defeat** Ibrahim Lodi.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd1533b356e7b226814ec297c8a95240c787783dae52fb86ca60b2e18064d712.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Battle of Khanwa was challenge between **the forces of the first Mughal Emperor Babur and the Rajput forces led by Rana Sanga of Mewar**, after the Battle of Panipat.​ 
 
• The Battle of Chausa was fought between **the Mughal emperor, Humayun, and the Afghan, Sher Shah Suri**.
 
• The Battle of Chanderi happened in the aftermath of the **Battle of Khanwa** in which the Mughal Emperor Babur had defeated a confederacy of **Rajputs and Afghans. **** **
